newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries seen flat Tuesday ahead of data.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries seen flat Tuesday ahead of data.

text.p: The prices of U.S. government securities likely will remain rangebound Tuesday ahead of important economic data releases later in the week.
Traders said activity ground to a halt on Monday amid a dearth of meaningful new numbers to digest. That and thin trading helped to exaggerate price movements.

"It's absolutely dead," said Cary Leahey, senior economist at Lehman Government Securities. He saw activity remaining muted until Thursday's release of producer price data and Friday's crucial nonfarm payrolls report.
